name: Legends Showcase
blurb: Fifty iconic planeswalkers, titans, dragons, and eternal staples painted across ten signature fine-art series.
blurbEs: Cincuenta planeswalkers, titanes, dragones y clásicos eternos pintados en diez series artísticas.

sets.name: Tarot Planeswalkers
sets.style: gilded medieval tarot oil painting with indigo velvet skies, celestial compass halos, and gold-leaf drapery

items.subject: a hooded mind mage weaving luminous azure illusion runes above a dark marble dais
a regal necromancer wrapped in violet shadow silk with an ancient silver veil
a pyromancer crowned in roaring golden-orange flame standing on volcanic slate
an armored solar knight raising a radiant gilded spear beneath a sunburst halo
a timeless scholar parting glowing amber hourglass sands across a twilight arch

sets.name: Pauper Heroes
sets.style: gritty painterly fantasy illustration in weathered coastal blues, warm torchlight ochre, and expressive oil brushwork

items.subject: a colossal abyssal sea serpent coiling around sunken academy arches under storm surf
a bioluminescent swamp leviathan rising from misty black water beside gnarled roots
an agile sky scout leaping between cliff ledges on braided ropes with hooked steel
a luminous drifting river elemental with translucent fin-wings gliding over twilight reeds
a masked underworld ferryman carrying a glowing brass censer across still gray water

sets.name: Eldrazi Lithographs
sets.style: surreal cosmic lithograph and gouache in dusty bone ivory, iridescent amethyst, and chalky basalt void

items.subject: a titanic floating lattice-winged cosmic entity bending a moonlit horizon into spirals
a towering twin-armed bone-masked titan turning a canyon into floating chalk dust
an obsidian-crowned geometric colossus hovering beneath floating fractured prisms
a gaunt pale void stalker peering into fractured violet crystalline mirrors
a charging monolithic horror shattering crystalline spires in a shockwave of lilac light

sets.name: Dragon Folio
sets.style: dramatic high-fantasy oil painting in volcanic crimson, burnished gold, and billowing ember smoke

items.subject: a classic crimson mountain dragon roaring atop a smoking basalt spire at sunset
an ancient horned elder dragon coiled around a floating golden gem between twin horns
a gleaming gilded dragon banking through sunlit storm clouds scattering molten gold
a jagged horned magma dragon perched on a glowing volcanic ridge under ash skies
a massive emerald forest wyrm curled atop a mossy hoard of ancient bronze relics

sets.name: Goblin Sketchbook
sets.style: lively inked watercolor and gouache field illustration in rusty red, soot charcoal, and warm lantern amber

items.subject: a grinning ragged scout waving a flaming torch while sprinting across a rocky pass
a scrappy armored goblin charging ahead carrying a battered iron shield and club
a wise scarred goblin matriarch pointing from a cliffside encampment of war banners
a helmeted goblin chief standing atop a rickety wooden siege catapult with lit fuses
an ostentatious goblin warlord seated on a gilded scrap-iron throne surrounded by banners

sets.name: Angel Fresco
sets.style: renaissance cathedral ceiling fresco painted in warm ivory plaster, lapis azure, and hammered gold leaf

items.subject: a serene winged warrior hovering in golden shafts of light with sword drawn and calm gaze
a radiant silver-armored angel sweeping down with blazing crimson-tipped wings
a solemn silver-haired guardian angel descending with a gleaming collar spear under moonlight
a sunrise-lit archangel raising a blazing banner of white feathers above marble clouds
a young luminous angel channeling golden halo ribbons over an art-deco sanctuary

sets.name: Artifact Blueprints
sets.style: artificer workshop gouache on Prussian-blue drafting linen with luminous chalk linework and warm brass highlights

items.subject: a segmented brass-and-steel mechanical wurm coiling around glowing turquoise power cores
a towering dark-iron juggernaut striding through emerald alchemical vapor and sparks
a spindly bronze spider-legged siege engine bristling with glowing arcane bolts
a melancholy weathered clockwork automaton standing quietly in a misty pine glade
an intricate articulated brass-and-onyx crown harness humming with amber arcs

sets.name: Graveyard Woodblock
sets.style: moody hand-carved woodblock print with mossy sage, bone parchment, and deep ink shadows

items.subject: a colossal horned archdemon rising behind iron cathedral bars with outstretched wings
a masked winged judge perched atop a dark winged steed over ash-covered ruins
a ferocious tangled elemental beast of thorny roots and glowing moss surging from forest loam
a drifting crimson-shrouded phantom gliding over moonlit tombstones and dead grass
a hulking moss-and-fungus covered troll lumbering through a misty bog graveyard

sets.name: Storm Calligraphy
sets.style: sweeping sumi-e ink and electric cobalt watercolor with violent silver lightning and vermilion seal accents

items.subject: whirling ribbons of obsidian ink spiraling around a shadowed mage in a tempest
a cascading volley of glowing scarlet-and-amber firebolts streaking across ink-black clouds
burning parchment scrolls swirling upward into a bright phoenix-shaped pillar of fire
a surging silhouette wave of tiny horned warriors pouring out of jagged canyon tunnels
a floating gilded ring-orb channeling brilliant sapphire plasma arcs across a dark dome

sets.name: Classic Iconics
sets.style: timeless classic high-fantasy oil painting in rich earth umber, verdant forest green, and warm twilight gold

items.subject: a muscular bone-plated predator stalking through ancient mossy ruins under green mist
a trench-coated arcane duelist snapping bright blue sparks from his fingertips in a rainy alley
a sharp-eyed robed spymaster studying forbidden parchment by a single tallow candle
a pale runesmith lifting a gleaming white-hot blade from an anvil of floating stone
a towering mountain-shouldered giant striding through sunlit pine valleys with ancient trees on its back
